description: qa-orchestrator guardrails (docs/design.md §6). Install the plugin at project/local scope so these load only in the target repo; there they stay dormant unless the current session owns an active QA run (.qa-runs/active.json). The SubagentStop recorder appends agent telemetry to RUN/events.jsonl, saves each agent handback to RUN/outputs/<step>.md, and never blocks.
